description: This file defines the DownloadAttachmentController class responsible for handling download requests for attachments. It retrieves attachment data, generates the file path, audits the download action, and streams the file to the client.

classes.name: DownloadAttachmentController
classes.description: Controller handling the download of attachment files, including authorization, file retrieval, logging, and streaming the file response.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies: attachment repository, file path service, and audit log service.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the download request, retrieves attachment, audits it, and returns a streamed response.

methods.name: auditAction
methods.description: Logs the download action in the audit log.
